DATE:              October 13, 1988
SUBJECT:        1. Permit Requirements for Places of Assembly.

                2. Sprinkler Requirements for Catering Establishments
                   and Banquet Halls,



1.    Pursuant to Section 27-522, a Place of Assembly Permit shall be
      required for rooms or spaces located either on the same floor or
      on different floors with a combined occupancy of seventy five
      (75) or more persons even if each room or space has less than
      seventy five (75) persons when there is no complete one-hour fire
      separation between those rooms or spaces. This section applies
      to all new and existing assembly spaces.

2.    Pursuant to Section 27-929(a) and Section 27-954(v), sprinklers
      shall be required for rooms or spaces used as catering
      establishments and banquet halls located either on the same floor
      or an different floors with a combined occupancy of three hundred
      (300) or more persons even if each room or space has less than
      three hundred (300) persons when there is no complete one-hour
      fire separation between those rooms or spaces. This section
      applies to all new and existing catering establishments and
      banquet halls.
